name: hyperrizz
title: Hyperrizz
tagline: Tell Hermes the story. Watch your film take shape.

stats.tokens_note: Not stated in the README or v2.1.0 release notes.

tests.note: README: 8 real-FFmpeg regression tests covering valid media, failure cases, and a near-black or blank frame 0. CI covers package integrity and verifier regression tests; the full browser/render smoke test is documented in VALIDATION.md.

stats.source: README.md at v2.1.0; GitHub release notes for v2.1.0; catalog YAML for tool names

features: Agent-led HyperFrames films with a live review pane, frame notes, revisions, and on-demand full Studio
v2.1.0 money shot: every delivered film opens on a finished hero at full brightness so frame 0 works as a thumbnail
Local Node/Chromium/FFmpeg production; no API keys or hosted generation
Starter pinned to HyperFrames 0.9.23; Linux is the tested production platform
verify-media.py extracts frame 0 and rejects a near-black or blank opening
use_cases: Tell Hermes the story and have it materialize a HyperFrames project you can review in the live pane
Leave frame-specific notes and request a revision pass without leaving chat
Open the full HyperFrames Studio when you want to edit the film yourself
Deliver a film that starts on a readable hero/title frame (the v2.1.0 money-shot default), suitable as a social thumbnail
Run the broadcast lab example (docs/examples/broadcast-lab.png and contact sheet in img/) as a known production check
Verify the finished MP4 with the packaged verifier, including the frame-0 hero check
install:
hermes plugins install mojomast/hyperrizz --ref 35c482e22413ee43c74955bd6da7fe7b053cdd9b
hermes plugins enable hyperrizz

The package includes the agent tools and desktop/plugin.js. For a remote Hermes backend, install the Desktop half on the client through Install Plugin as well. The first build installs the pinned npm dependencies automatically. Linux is the tested production platform; macOS is declared but not yet tested. Platforms in the catalog entry: linux, macos.

video.note: No submission/demo MP4 was found in the plugin repository or in local delivery folders. Do not fetch the X post video. The repo does contain docs/examples/broadcast-lab.mp4, an example film produced by the plugin; that file is not confirmed as the hackathon X demo, so it is not shipped here as video.mp4. Still frames from that example are in img/ (broadcast-lab.png, broadcast-contact-sheet.jpg).
